sample_unit: EEG recordings (benchmark datasets Mumtaz2016 and TUAB)
unlisted_practices: Applying gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based attribution methods to explain EEG foundation model predictions
Population-level evaluation of explanation reliability using AOPC and cross-method consistency
Checking model explanations against established neurophysiological markers to detect artifact or spurious-pattern dependence
Using an LLM to convert structured attribution outputs into natural-language reports

screen.reason: Evaluates an attribution and explanation framework (including LLM-generated reports) applied to EEG foundation models on benchmark datasets to assess interpretability, reliability, and artifact detection.
